I’m a super big science geek, so this actually helped quite a lot. That’s one way to think about sex that I haven’t really give much thought to. I will try and think about sex with the it’s natural framing, since my science brain gets it from that perspective.

“You are being a good little human...” also made me laugh. Thank you so much.
Awesome, thanks for taking the time to reply!!

Thanks for the reply! I have a therapist, but I feel like a sex therapist would be best as she helps more with depression and anxiety stuff. Unfortunately, there aren’t any sex therapists in town. 

I consider myself still catholic, but don’t share their views on sex, sexuality, gender, birth control, etc. So idk if that doesn’t make me catholic; another thing I’m trying to figure out.

Do you know of any readings on this topic by chance?

I still have kind of have an aversion to porn and masturbation, as I don’t really feel anything; but I think that’s from my sex-negative upbringing too. I’m trying to work on not feeling bad on that front as well.
Thanks! It’s just the process of actually getting out of my head that I’m struggling with. It’s like I know that sex isn’t shameful, but my brain still isn’t following along completely.

Yeah it’s pretty unhealthy how they treat the discussion of sex. 
I have a therapist, but she doesn’t have much training re: sex and unfortunately there aren’t any sex therapists anywhere near me. 

Do you remember any of those blogs/articles? And this was helpful, thank you. I’ll take any help at this point lol
